draft.title: Waybill Procurement Automation Investment Assessment
draft.purpose: Evaluate hardware procurement platform viability and address founder intro request strategy.

sections.heading: Observed Business & Value
sections.content: Waybill connects engineers to procurement leads via AI sourcing (E3). It manages end-to-end flow from BOM to shelf inventory (E5). Team size is 3 employees based in Gurugram (E6, E8). Founded in 2026.

sections.heading: Problem & Alternatives
sections.content: Hardware teams burn weeks on quotes and tracking (E2). Engineers need specific alternates they can't hand off (E4). Competitors stop at approved POs (E5). Value is automated delivery matching. Monetization is unknown.

sections.heading: Decision & Unknowns
sections.content: Founder seeks intros, not yet revenue confirmation (E1). Team experience includes LAT Aerospace but lacks commercial traction data. Need retention evidence before proceeding. Missing inputs include procurement volume records.

missing_inputs.why: Determine repeat demand vs trial adoption.
Establish monetization hypothesis before scaling outreach.

draft.completion_test: Output must compare procurement volume vs delivery time metrics without fabricated numbers.

draft.title: Waybill Preliminary Investment Case
draft.purpose: Assess acquisition hypothesis and suitability for advisory engagement based on founder request.

sections.heading: Observed Business
sections.content: Hardware teams face fragmented procurement workflows involving multiple distributors, approvals, and tracking challenges. Waybill automates this loop from sourcing to inventory (E2, E3). Founders leverage backgrounds in aerospace and AI supply chain systems (E4, E10) but currently operate with limited staff.

sections.heading: Value Proposition & Hypothesis
sections.content: The hypothesis posits Waybill reduces engineering time by handling end-to-end procurement logistics and customs. Value is defined as speed and risk mitigation for hardware teams rather than upfront pricing. Monetization remains undefined in public records.

sections.heading: Unknowns & Objections
sections.content: Evidence regarding customer acquisition cost, revenue models, and churn rates is absent. Requesting intros to procurement leads indicates a need for initial trust-building rather than sales data (E1). Scalability remains unproven at this stage.

missing_inputs.why: To validate pricing model and delivery obligations.
To measure retention impact of the procurement solution.
To calculate unit economics and cash timing.

draft.decision_question: Is the procurement automation model scalable beyond current team capacity?
draft.next_action: Prepare a sourced prospect brief targeting hardware enterprise procurement leaders.
draft.completion_test: Verify if outreach generates committed trial contracts or explicit revenue metrics from target clients.
